Name: GreenhouseUpgrades
Author: Cecidelus
Description:
This mod allows you to Upgrade your greenhouse!

[color=#6aa84f][b]Translated into Portuguese and Spanish[/b][/color]
[color=#cc0000][size=2]I made the Spanish translation and maybe is not the best but it's there![/size][/color]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content PatcherI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[color=#e69138]The Mod folder will have 2 others folders (SMAPI Code Mod and CP Mod), both are needed for the mod to work.[/color]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Once you unlocked the Greenhouse (Community Center or Joja) you can upgrade it from Robin. Each Upgrade takes 2 days and increases the growing space you have!

[size=4]Upgrades:[/size]

[size=3]Big Greenhouse:[/size]

[size=2]Materials:[/size]
[list]
[*] 200000 Gold
[*] 300 Stone
[*] 20 Iron Bar
[*] 50 Clay
[/list]

[size=2]Features:[/size]
[list]
[*] 15x15 growing space ([b]105 new tiles[/b])
[/list]

[size=3]Deluxe Greenhouse:[/size]

[size=2]Materials:[/size]
[list]
[*] 500000 Gold
[*] 500 Stone
[*] 25 Iridium Sprinkler
[*] 30 Battery Pack
[/list]

[size=2]Features:[/size]
[list]
[*] 21x21 growing space ([b]321 new tiles[/b] [i]vanilla greenhouse[/i] | 216 [i]Big Greenhouse[/i])
[*] Auto-watering system
[*] The painel outside the greenhouse turns green when crops inside are ready for harvest (on the soil or on Garden Pots)
[/list]
[i]
*Edit the mod config to change the materials needed.

[/i][size=5]Config file:
[/size]You can find the config file on GreenhouseUpgrades/GreenhouseUpgrades/config.json. There you will find the fallowing configurations:
[list]
[*]MoveFruitTrees: Enable (true) / Disable (false) the fruit tree move after an upgrade.
[*]UpgradePrice1: 1st upgrade cost.
[*]UpgradePrice2: 2nd upgrade cost.
[*]UpgradeMaterials1: The intems (ids) and quantities needed for the 1st upgrade. ( As of { "ID1" : QNT1, "ID2" : QNT2, ...})
[*]UpgradeMaterials2: The intems (ids) and quantities needed for the 2nd upgrade. ( As of { "ID1" : QNT1, "ID2" : QNT2, ...})
[/list]
[size=4]Customizing:[/size]
[list]
[*]You can change the upgrade maps used by replacing [i]Greenhouse_1.tmx[/i] and/or [i]Greenhouse_2.tmx[/i], changing the map used on that upgrade! It's better to disable ﻿[i]MoveFruitTrees[/i] if you change any map because the source and target areas where the fruit trees should be can change from map to map.
[*]You can change the [i]Greenhouse_1.png[/i] file to change the looks of the 1st upgrade.
[*]You can add a [i]Greenhouse_2.png[/i] to add a unique look to the 2nd upgrade.
[*]You can add seasonal appearences to the greenhouse at upgrade 1 and 2 by adding a [b][SEASON][/b]_Greenhouse_[b][UPGRADE][/b].png (Ex. winter_Greenhouse_2.png).
[/list]
[i]*At level 2, the building aparence will be the same as level 1, but with the painel, if no level 2 file is found.
*If a seasonal file is missing, the default (not sasonal) file will be used, if it exists.

[/i][size=5]V1.1.0 Notes:
[/size][list]
[*]Fruit trees on the bottom and rigth side in the greenhouse are now moved after the upgrade! They stay in the same relative place, out of the crop area.
[*]You can now add seasonal appearece to the greenhouse exterior. See [i]Customizing[/i] above.
[*]Added a console command to move fruit trees if you already upgraded your greenhouse and want to move yours! Type [b][i]move_trees 1[/i][/b] to move fruit trees from vanilla positions to Upgrade 1 positions. Type [b][i]move_trees 2[/i][/b] to move them from upgrade 1 to 2 positions.
[*]Added Turkish translation (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108727003]KeDili[/url]).
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility:[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5
[*]Works in single player
[*]Works in multiplayer¹
[/list]

[size=5]Know Issues:[/size]
Robin stays in the middle of the greenhouse while upgrading. [s]That's a issue for me at least.[/s]
¹On multiplayer, only the host sees the upgrade, others need to relog. (Investigating)
